description.value: North Garden Cafe is a Hong Kong-style Chinese restaurant in Coquitlam serving an extensive menu of seafood, hot pot, congee, chow mein, and more. The restaurant offers dine-in, takeout, and delivery with online ordering available. It accepts cash or debit only.

address.value: 552 Clarke Road Suite 411, Coquitlam, BC V3J 3X5

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (10 spaces, covered) at 90m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms this is a Hong Kong-style Chinese restaurant at 552 Clarke Road Suite 411, Coquitlam, BC — not North Vancouver as the OSM community tag suggests. The site explicitly advertises dine-in, takeout, and delivery, and the contact page provides a phone number absent from OSM. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM community tag says 'North Vancouver' but the restaurant is in Coquitlam, BC per the website address (552 Clarke Road Suite 411, Coquitlam, BC V3J 3X5) and all website branding. OSM coordinates (49.2615, -122.8884) also correspond to Coquitlam, not North Vancouver.
Phone number (604) 421-8863 sourced from website only; OSM has no phone field populated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open, publicly accessible restaurant with a confirmed website, phone, and address. Useful to touring cyclists as a dine-in or takeout food stop.

wow_evidence: Hong Kong-style Chinese restaurant serving an extensive menu
